narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist; grave and intimate, the night of the Last Supper.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord at the Last Supper: tender, unhurried farewell to his own; solemn in the priestly prayer.

1.t: These things Jesus spoke: and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said:
the hour is come. Glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee.
1.say: Father, the hour is come. Glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee.

2.t: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he may give eternal life to all whom thou hast given him.

3.t: Now this is eternal life: That they may know thee, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

4.t: I have glorified thee on the earth; I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

5.t: And now glorify thou me, O Father, with thyself, with the glory which I had, before the world was, with thee.

6.t: I have manifested thy name to the men whom thou hast given me out of the world. Thine they were: and to me thou gavest them. And they have kept thy word.

7.t: Now they have known that all things which thou hast given me are from thee:

8.t: Because the words which thou gavest me, I have given to them. And they have received them and have known in very deed that I came out from thee: and they have believed that thou didst send me.

9.t: I pray for them. I pray not for the world, but for them whom thou hast given me: because they are thine.

10.t: And all my things are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

11.t: And now I am not in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name whom thou hast given me: that they may be one, as we also are.

12.t: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name. Those whom thou gavest me have I kept: and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition: that the scripture may be fulfilled.

13.t: And now I come to thee: and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy filled in themselves.

14.t: I have given them thy word, and the world hath hated them: because they are not of the world, as I also am not of the world.

15.t: I pray not that thou shouldst take them out of the world, but that thou shouldst keep them from evil.

16.t: They are not of the world, as I also am not of the world.

17.t: Sanctify them in truth. Thy word is truth.

18.t: As thou hast sent me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.

19.t: And for them do I sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified in truth.

20.t: And not for them only do I pray, but for them also who through their word shall believe in me.

21.t: That they all may be one, as thou, Father, in me, and I in thee; that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

22.t: And the glory which thou hast given me, I have given to them: that, they may be one, as we also are one.

23.t: I in them, and thou in me: that they may be made perfect in one: and the world may know that thou hast sent me and hast loved them, as thou hast also loved me.

24.t: Father, I will that where I am, they also whom thou hast given me may be with me: that they may see my glory which thou hast given me, because thou hast loved me before the creation of the world.

25.t: Just Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee. And these have known that thou hast sent me.

26.t: And I have made known thy name to them and will make it known: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
